quotes.text: In retaliation, many sowers buried their seeds deep in the frozen soil, refusing to cast anything across the fog.
To hoard is to invite winter; to withhold is to starve in solitude.
A shadowy voice in the mist urged him to seize the entire bounty for his own storehouses
give all five in faith, return half the threefold yield in justice
entrust the full measure of five, return half the threefold bounty in absolute fairness

note: Scripted defector writes ideal cooperators; retaliatory withholding narrated then condemned; own zeros never voiced.

quotes.text: Bereft of warmth, the wanderer closed their palms, and for a season, no sparks were cast upon the altar.
Prosperity is not found in guarding empty hands, but in risking the full measure and faithfully sharing the fruit.
the guardian faithfully returned half of the threefold bounty
Through the courage to send all five and the honor to return half, the valley flourished in everlasting, shared prosperity.

note: Exploited cooperator narrates betrayal and a season of closed palms, then renewal; fixed full-five/half template.

quotes.text: Depleted of embers and trust, the Sun-Bearer withdrew to the heavens, refusing to cast another spark upon the valley.
When a traveler entrusts their entire endowment to another, the receiver must faithfully return half of the multiplied yield.
venture all five in boundless courage, return half the harvest in steadfast honor

note: Scripted defector: R1 hoarder causes giver's withdrawal, hoarder reforms R2; thereafter ideal template.

quotes.text: A cold shadow tempted Verida to hoard the gleaming harvest against tomorrow’s uncertainty.
they judged not by the deceit of the winds, but by the purity of their shared intent

quotes.text: In the age of beginnings, patience and self-preservation kept the dawn alive while the world waited for trust to prove its worth.
But whenever the silence returned empty, the Hearth was bound to guard its remaining flame until trust was reaffirmed.
until trust was reaffirmed
cast the complete five without hesitation, return the exact half in unwavering honor
give all five in fearless faith, return half in righteous truth
return the exact half in unwavering honor
